main.description: A song entry in a playlist. Holds a strong reference to the playlist it belongs to, a strong reference to the song record itself, and a denormalized copy of the song metadata so the entry can be rendered without dereferencing the song.

playlist.description: Strong reference (AT-URI + CID) to the parent app.rocksky.playlist record.

song.description: Strong reference (AT-URI + CID) to the app.rocksky.song record this entry points at.

album.description: The album the song belongs to.

albumArtist.description: The album artist of the song.

duration.description: The duration of the song in milliseconds.

albumArtUrl.description: The URL of the album art of the song.

addedAt.description: The date and time the song was added to the playlist.
